scope: Full audit: bin/007, hooks, agents, loop rules, docs, backlog

findings.title: lane_guard and git_guard fail open on malformed input
findings.description: json.load and payload.get are unguarded, so bad or non-object input raises and exits 1. Claude Code blocks only on exit 2, so the tool call proceeds. Probed: 'not json' -> exit 1 (lane_guard), '[]' -> exit 1 (git_guard). agent_guard and adr_write_guard fail closed.
findings.suggestion: Catch unreadable or non-dict input and return 2, as agent_guard.py does. Hook change: Brian's hand.
findings.resolution_notes: Both hooks catch unreadable or non-object input and return 2; tests added. Commit 707ef86.

findings.title: git_guard misses git invoked by path
findings.description: The boundary class before 'git' lacks '/', so '/usr/bin/git commit' passes (probed: exit 0). The coordinator's HEAD check is the backstop, but the reviewer has none.
findings.suggestion: Add '/' to the boundary character class and a test.
findings.resolution_notes: Added '/' to the boundary class; tests for /usr/bin/git and /opt/homebrew/bin/git. Commit 707ef86.

findings.title: No diff check after the reviewer runs
findings.description: The reviewer has Bash and git_guard but no lane guard; only its prompt stops shell writes. The diff check runs after triad dispatches only, so a reviewer write would ride into the next commit unnoticed.
findings.suggestion: Run the same diff check after every reviewer dispatch; any change is a violation.
findings.resolution_notes: CLAUDE.md: diff check after every reviewer dispatch; any change is a violation. The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: Reviewer description invites per-change auto-dispatch
findings.description: 'Use proactively after the developer or refactorer finishes a change' contradicts the once-per-scope review and the fixed dispatch prompt. Auto-delegation writes its own prompt, which can carry the builders' reasoning.
findings.suggestion: Describe it as dispatched by the main session after a verified DONE, or on request.
findings.resolution_notes: Description now: dispatched by the main session once per scope after a verified DONE. The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: Architect can write an ADR outside record mode
findings.description: 'Use proactively' in the description, plus workflow step 6 (write when the recommendation is final), lets an auto-dispatched architect write an ADR the human never decided. The loop's 'accepted only after the human decides' holds only when a mode is named.
findings.suggestion: Make recommend the default when no mode is named; write only in record mode.
findings.resolution_notes: Description drops 'proactively'; recommend is the default mode; ADRs written only in record mode after the human decides. The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: init over an existing install mixes versions
findings.description: plan_copy skips an existing .007-version but copies files new in the newer release. A later remove compares against the old commit, so those files are orphaned silently.
findings.suggestion: Refuse init when .007-version exists and point to remove first. Add a test.
findings.resolution_notes: init refuses when .007-version exists (INIT-04); tests added. Commit 707ef86.

findings.title: FW-12 still marked doing after PR #3 merged
findings.description: PR #3 (feat/agent-teamwork) is merged into main; the backlog item still says doing and sits under Todo.
findings.suggestion: Mark it done and move it to Done.
findings.resolution_notes: FW-12 marked done (PR #3) and moved to Done. The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: FW-12 out-of-scope items aren't tracked
findings.description: 4a refactor-pass cost, 4b resuming the manager, 4c cheaper models, 4d the diff check's ignored files, 3b ownership lines, 3c 'ministry systems' were deferred, but none is in the backlog.
findings.suggestion: Add them to the backlog or drop them explicitly.
findings.resolution_notes: Added FW-14 listing 4a-4d and 3b; 3c handled by finding 009. The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: Personal context ships to adopters
findings.description: 'Most internal and ministry systems have no growth loop' is Brian-specific (FW-12's 3c).
findings.resolution_notes: Reworded to 'Most internal systems' (Brian chose rewording over a profile item). The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: Attack categories are HTTP-client specific
findings.description: Retry-After, pagination, sync wrappers in event loops come from the first project, a Python HTTP client. The framework claims any language; other projects mark most categories not applicable on every sweep.
findings.suggestion: Keep the generic categories; move domain ones to the Project profile's Domain attacks.
findings.resolution_notes: HTTP failures, retries, and pagination moved to the Domain attacks example in AGENTS.md. The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: Placeholder scripts point to a missing doc
findings.description: check, test, and lint say 'See README.md, Adopting'. The README isn't shipped, and 007's README has no Adopting section (it's 'Configure a project').
findings.suggestion: Point to AGENTS.md's Project profile or name the 007 README section by URL.
findings.resolution_notes: Placeholders now point to AGENTS.md, Setup and checks. The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: Attribution trailer has no source
findings.description: The EM is told to use 'the attribution trailer you are given', but the main session's dispatch inputs don't include one.
findings.suggestion: Add it to the dispatch inputs in CLAUDE.md, or drop the line.
findings.resolution_notes: Dropped the trailer clause; Claude Code adds its own attribution. The docs commit on fix/audit-findings, after 707ef86.

findings.title: Lessons cite backlog items that don't exist
findings.description: FW-05 and FW-09 are named as 'Led to', but neither is in docs/backlog.md (they're from the first project).
findings.suggestion: Note they're the first project's IDs, or record them under Done.

findings.title: 007 has no CI
findings.description: The gate runs only locally; nothing checks PRs. The README tells adopters CI should run their gate.
findings.suggestion: Add a minimal GitHub Actions job running ./scripts/check (CI change: needs approval).

findings.title: Batch splitting will prompt mid-run
findings.description: Split on struggle resets the branch, and git reset is on the ask list, so an unattended run stops for a prompt there.
findings.suggestion: Decide whether that's intended; if so, say so in CLAUDE.md's batch scaling.
